comparison.objective: Raise a piano lid, set its prop into the cup, and lower the lid safely onto it.
comparison.physical_skill: One arm continuously supports a load while the other aligns and inserts a hinged prop.
comparison.success_condition: Lid rests unsupported by grippers on the seated prop; a detected lid fall irreversibly scores zero. Exact final tolerances are not supplied.
comparison.reason: Support-and-prop insertion is a different tested mechanism from bimanual hammering, fracture-load regulation, and debris recovery.
